Lower Text: [Security] You may play 1 Tamer card with inherited effects from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, add this card to the hand.
Upper Text: While you have a Tamer or a Digimon with the [Hybrid] trait, you may ignore this card's color requirements.

[Main] You may return 1 Digimon card with the [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] trait from your trash to the hand. Then, you may play 1 Digimon card with the [Ten Warriors] trait or 1 Tamer card with inherited effects from your hand with the play cost reduced by 4.
